Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. videos.caption: Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Mini Banana Pudding Cheesecakes 🍌🤎 Banana pudding meets cheesecake, and baby, the combination is SO good! 🫶🏽 Creamy banana cheesecake filling, a buttery Nilla Wafer crust, and homemade banana whipped cream on top. You need these in your life! 🍌 CHEESECAKE FILLING • 2 (8 oz) blocks cream cheese, softened • 2/3 cup granulated sugar • 1/2 tbsp vanilla bean paste • 1/3 cup mashed banana • 2 large eggs + 1 egg yolk 🍪 NILLA WAFER CRUST • 1–1 1/4 cups crushed Nilla Wafers (about 20–25 wafers) • 1/2 cup (1 stick) salted butter, melted • 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon 🍦 BANANA WHIPPED CREAM • 1 cup cold heavy whipping cream • 1 tbsp instant banana cream pudding mix • 3/4 tsp vanilla extract TOPPINGS • Banana slices • Nilla Wafers INSTRUCTIONS 1. Preheat oven to 325°F and line a cupcake pan with liners. 2. Mix the crushed Nilla Wafers, melted butter, and cinnamon until combined. Press the mixture into the liners and bake for 7 minutes. Let cool. 3. Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Mix in the mashed banana and vanilla bean paste. 4. Slowly add the eggs and egg yolk, mixing until smooth. 5. Spoon the cheesecake filling over the cooled crusts, filling almost to the top. 6. Bake at 325°F for 18–22 minutes, until puffed and mostly set. Cool in the pan for 15–20 minutes. 7. Refrigerate for 2–4 hours, or until completely chilled. 8. Whip the heavy cream, banana cream pudding mix, and vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Refrigerate until ready to use. 9. Pipe the banana whipped cream onto the chilled cheesecakes and finish with a banana slice and Nilla Wafer. Creamy Chicken & Leek Puff Pastry Hand Pies 🥧 My husband made these for dinner earlier this week and I knew right away we had to get this one up on the website ASAP…they’re SO good! The filling is delicious enough to eat on its own, but wrapped in flaky puff pastry...this is my ideal comfort food. Pot pie, but portable! Full recipe is linked in our profile or head straight to https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/chicken-and-leek-hand-pies/ 2 tablespoons butter 1 cup sliced leeks white and pale green parts (1 large leek), halved lengthwise then sliced ¼ in ½ teaspoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour ½ cup chicken stock 1 cup shredded rotisserie chicken 2 tablespoons sour cream or crème fraîche ¾ teaspoon Dijon mustard 1½ teaspoon fresh tarragon finely chopped 1½ teaspoon fresh thyme finely chopped ¼ teaspoon black pepper 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed but cold 1 egg + 1 teaspoon water, beaten Fresh thyme sprigs  In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the leeks and salt, cooking for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. If they start to brown, reduce the heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Add the stock, stirring, and simmer for 2 minutes, until it thickens slightly. Turn off the heat and stir in the chicken, sour cream, Dijon, tarragon, thyme, and pepper. Taste for salt and adjust as desired. Chill until fully cold or at least room temperature, about 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 400˚F and line two sheet pans with parchment paper. If you have enough sheet pans, we like to stack a second sheet pan underneath each one so the bottoms of the pastry don't brown too quickly. On a floured surface, roll each sheet of puff pastry to about 13×13 inches. We use a 3 ½-inch circular cookie cutter for the bottoms – cut 9-10 circles from one sheet of puff pastry (or as many as you can fit). On the other sheet of puff pastry, we use a ~4-inch cookie cutter for the tops. Again, cut out 9-10 circles, or as many as you can fit. Mound 2 tablespoons of cooled filling on each bottom circle of puff pastry, leaving a border around the edges. Brush egg wash all around the border. Top with the slightly bigger top circle, pressing firmly all the way around the edges to make sure it's well sealed and there are no air pockets. Use a fork to firmly crimp the edges together. Optional: use the 3 ½-inch cookie cutter to re-trim the circle so it looks neat! Brush the tops of each pastry with a thin, but even layer of egg wash. Using a sharp paring knife, poke several holes in the top so steam can escape. To decorate with thyme leaves, dip the sprig in some egg wash, then press it onto the top of the pastry. Bake for ~22 minutes, rotating the pan at 15 minutes, until the pastries are deep golden on both the top and bottom. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas
